policies.title: EU, EEA, Swiss and French ordinary passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: France-Visas and the Interior Ministry directly exempt EU, EEA and Swiss citizens from overseas visas. FR is visa_free, not citizenship: GF, FW, YT and RE are territorial destination codes rather than France itself.
conditions: Ordinary passport held as a citizen of the listed EU, EEA or Swiss state, for a visitor stay up to 90 days.
This does not normalize residence, work, family-member residence cards, identity-document alternatives, transit, special passports or final admission.
All four catalog destinations are outside Schengen; the classification follows free-movement rights rather than a Schengen visa.

policies.title: Named French Guiana ordinary passports: visa-free visitor stays
policies.summary: The current DROM Annex II schedule directly waives the French Guiana visitor visa for this ordinary-passport cohort. Geographic exceptions, document-qualified waivers and paid activity remain separate.
conditions: Short visitor stay up to 90 days in 180 days. The work-authorisation exceptions for Australia, Japan, Republic of Korea, Mexico, Singapore, the United States and Venezuela do not apply to ordinary tourism or family visits.
Hong Kong and Macao are SAR passport entries only, not a PRC ordinary-passport rule.
The schedule's passport-specific, French multi-entry-visa, residence-permit, cruise, transit, diplomatic, service, special-document and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Ecuadorian ordinary passports: visa-free French Guiana visitor stays
policies.summary: The DROM Annex II expressly grants Ecuador all-passport visa exemption for French Guiana, while treating Réunion differently.
conditions: Short visitor stay up to 90 days in 180 days; excludes work, residence, transit, diplomatic/service and final-admission conditions.
This is not generalized to Réunion, Mayotte, or the aggregate French West Indies destination.

policies.title: Dominican and Saint Lucian ordinary passports: limited French Guiana visa-free visits
policies.summary: The DROM Annex II directly grants Dominica and Saint Lucia a French Guiana ordinary-passport waiver only for the specified short duration.
conditions: Only stays of 15 days or less, within 120 cumulative days in 12 months.
Does not establish a waiver for a longer stay, work, residence, transit, cruise, special passport or other document condition.

policies.title: Named Réunion ordinary passports: visa-free visitor stays
policies.summary: The current DROM Annex II schedule directly waives the Réunion visitor visa for this ordinary-passport cohort. The listed work exceptions and document-qualified routes are retained as conditions.
conditions: Short visitor stay up to 90 days in 180 days. The work-authorisation exceptions for Australia, Japan, Republic of Korea, Mexico, Singapore, the United States and Venezuela do not apply to ordinary tourism or family visits.
Hong Kong and Macao are SAR passport entries only, not a PRC ordinary-passport rule.
The schedule's passport-specific, French multi-entry-visa, residence-permit, cruise, transit, diplomatic, service, special-document and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Brazilian, South African, Mozambican, Dominican and Saint Lucian ordinary passports: visa-free Réunion visitor stays
policies.summary: The DROM Annex II directly distinguishes Réunion from French Guiana and grants the listed ordinary-passport visitor waivers.
conditions: Short visitor stay up to 90 days in 180 days. The ordinary visitor classification excludes the schedule's paid-activity/work-authorisation exception for Brazil.
For Dominica and Saint Lucia, Réunion has the full short-stay waiver; French Guiana has only the separate 15-day waiver.
No result is inferred for Mayotte or the French West Indies aggregate from this Réunion-specific material.

policies.title: Named Mayotte ordinary passports: visa-free visitor stays
policies.summary: The current Mayotte Annex II directly waives the visitor visa for this ordinary-passport cohort. The schedule differs from the DROM order in destination-specific rows, which are recorded separately.
conditions: Short visitor stay up to 90 days in 180 days. The work-authorisation exceptions for Australia, Japan, Republic of Korea, Mexico, Singapore, the United States and Venezuela do not apply to ordinary tourism or family visits.
Hong Kong and Macao are SAR passport entries only, not a PRC ordinary-passport rule.
The schedule's passport-specific, French multi-entry-visa, residence-permit, cruise, transit, diplomatic, service, special-document and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Brazilian, Mozambican, Dominican and Saint Lucian ordinary passports: visa-free Mayotte visitor stays
policies.summary: The current Mayotte Annex II directly grants ordinary-passport visitor waivers for these destination-specific rows.
conditions: Short visitor stay up to 90 days in 180 days; the ordinary visitor classification excludes the paid-activity/work-authorisation exception for Brazil.
No result is inferred for French Guiana, Réunion or the French West Indies aggregate from this Mayotte-specific material.

policies.title: Other French Guiana ordinary passports: advance territory visa required
policies.summary: The current DROM order requires a valid territory-specific visa unless an Annex II nationality exemption applies. This covers the ordinary-passport baseline after direct waivers and genuinely unresolved biometric rows are removed.
conditions: A valid visa must cover French Guiana; a Schengen visa alone does not authorize the territory. France-Visas' online workflow is application filing, not eVisa issuance.

French multi-entry-visa, residence-permit, long-stay visa, cruise, transit, crew, special/diplomatic/service passport and individual-admission exceptions remain conditional and do not change this ordinary-passport baseline.

Georgia's former Annex II exemption was removed effective June 2025. Vanuatu's waiver is restricted to pre-25-May-2015 ordinary passports, so it cannot establish a current unqualified ordinary-passport exemption.
Brazil's listed French Guiana exceptions are organized/brief/transit/frontier/emergency routes rather than a nationality-wide visitor waiver.

policies.title: Other Réunion ordinary passports: advance territory visa required
policies.summary: The current DROM order requires a valid territory-specific visa unless an Annex II nationality exemption applies. This covers the ordinary-passport baseline after direct waivers and genuinely unresolved biometric rows are removed.
conditions: A valid visa must cover Réunion; a Schengen visa alone does not authorize the territory. France-Visas' online workflow is application filing, not eVisa issuance.

French multi-entry-visa, residence-permit, long-stay visa, agency package, cruise, transit, crew, special/diplomatic/service passport and individual-admission exceptions remain conditional and do not change this ordinary-passport baseline.

Georgia's former Annex II exemption was removed effective June 2025. Vanuatu's waiver is restricted to pre-25-May-2015 ordinary passports, so it cannot establish a current unqualified ordinary-passport exemption.

policies.title: Other Mayotte ordinary passports: advance territory visa required
policies.summary: The current Mayotte order requires a valid territory-specific visa unless an Annex II nationality exemption applies. This covers the ordinary-passport baseline after direct waivers and genuinely unresolved biometric rows are removed.
conditions: A valid visa must cover Mayotte; a Schengen visa alone does not authorize the territory. France-Visas' online workflow is application filing, not eVisa issuance.

French multi-entry-visa, residence-permit, long-stay visa, cruise, transit, crew, special/diplomatic/service passport and individual-admission exceptions remain conditional and do not change this ordinary-passport baseline.

Georgia's former Annex II exemption was removed effective June 2025. Vanuatu's waiver is restricted to pre-25-May-2015 ordinary passports, so it cannot establish a current unqualified ordinary-passport exemption.
